title: CNBC Sport: Media 'upfront' advertising presentations have become an NFL showcase
raw_text:
Key Points
- NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell plans to attend the Disney advertising presentation in New York next week, sources told CNBC.
- YouTube and Netflix will both get additional live games as part of their NFL offerings for the 2026-27 season, sources told CNBC.
- The NFL schedule will likely be announced Wednesday or Thursday of next week, a source told CNBC.
